# Guildframe

> Tabletop crowdfunding launch studio led by Umair, for Kickstarter and Gamefound.

This supplemental summary does not replace the HTML pages or sitemap.

## Current service facts

- Services: launch planning, campaign creative, prelaunch landing pages and email, paid advertising, live campaign management and post campaign communication.
- Paid advertising: managed by Umair at Guildframe. Channels, access, spend limits and reporting are agreed in the project scope.
- Pricing: two fixed packages. The campaign page package is 1,800 US dollars and full campaign support is 5,900 US dollars. Media spend, software, platform fees and external production are separate costs. The campaign page scope is published at https://guildframe.com/campaign-design#pricing.
- Free mockup: one opening campaign section using supplied artwork, with no payment or obligation to book.
- Deliverables, fees, payment schedule, support dates and revisions: agreed in writing before work starts.
- Contact: umair@guildframe.com.
- Categories: board games, party and strategy card games, TCGs, TTRPGs, miniatures, STL collections, terrain, dice and tabletop accessories.
- Accounts and email contacts stay with the creator. Email signup flows require clear permission.
- Manufacturing, physical fulfilment, freight and tax decisions belong to the creator and relevant suppliers. Guildframe prepares the scoped launch work and communication.
- Concept imagery: original fictional game mockups generated with ImageGen and labelled as concepts.
- Past work: creative work for ScentedRealms, FutureProof Terrain, Quiver Time and Cryptic Explorers, with real Kickstarter links. These are creative examples, not attributed advertising results.
- Testimonials: two verbatim client excerpts about the creative work, matched to ScentedRealms and FutureProof Terrain.
- Historical Shopify guides remain useful after funding references at their original URLs.
- No guarantee of funding, advertising returns or search rankings.



## Start here: launching a tabletop Kickstarter

- [How to Launch a Board Game on Kickstarter](https://guildframe.com/guides/how-to-launch-a-board-game-on-kickstarter)
- [Kickstarter for Beginners: Questions First Time Tabletop Creators Ask](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-for-beginners): Kickstarter for beginners: plain answers to the questions first time tabletop creators ask about how it works, money, rules and where to start.
- [How to Market a Kickstarter Campaign: A Beginner's Guide for Tabletop Creators](https://guildframe.com/guides/how-to-market-a-kickstarter): How to market a Kickstarter when you have never done marketing before. What to do first, which channels suit a board game and what can wait.
- [How to Get Your First Kickstarter Backers When Nobody Knows Your Game](https://guildframe.com/guides/how-to-get-kickstarter-backers): How to get backers on Kickstarter when you have no audience. Where the first 100 people come from for a board game and what to ask them to do.
- [How to Design a Good Kickstarter Page for Your Board Game](https://guildframe.com/guides/how-to-design-a-kickstarter-page): How to design a good Kickstarter page for a board game. What goes first, what backers look for and how to make it look professional yourself.
- [Is My Game Ready for Kickstarter? What You Need Before You Launch](https://guildframe.com/guides/is-my-game-ready-for-kickstarter): What you need before you launch a board game on Kickstarter: how finished the game should be, how much art, and whether a prototype is enough.
- [How Much Does It Cost to Launch a Board Game on Kickstarter?](https://guildframe.com/guides/board-game-kickstarter-cost): How much it costs to launch a board game on Kickstarter, line by line. What you pay before launch, what comes out of the funding and where to save.
- [When Should You Launch Your Kickstarter, and How Long Does It Take to Prepare?](https://guildframe.com/guides/when-to-launch-a-kickstarter): How long it takes to prepare a board game Kickstarter and how to pick a launch date. Readiness signs, best days and dates to avoid.
- [What Makes a Kickstarter Fail, and How to Avoid It](https://guildframe.com/guides/why-kickstarter-campaigns-fail): Why board game Kickstarters fail and how to avoid it. The common reasons first time creators miss their goal, and what to do if a campaign is slow.

## Launch guides

- [How to Set a Kickstarter Funding Goal for a Board Game](https://guildframe.com/guides/board-game-kickstarter-funding-goal): Set a board game Kickstarter funding goal from factory minimums, fees, fulfillment and a reserve. Includes a calculator and a worked example.
- [How to Price Kickstarter Rewards for a Board Game](https://guildframe.com/guides/board-game-kickstarter-reward-pricing): Kickstarter pricing for board games: build each reward price from its real costs, fees and margin. See where a $40 pledge goes and test core and deluxe tiers.
- [How to Track Kickstarter Traffic with Referral Tags and UTMs](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-referral-tags-tracking): How to track Kickstarter traffic with referral tags, GA4 and Meta Pixel IDs, UTMs on your landing page, and a report that keeps clicks and pledges apart.
- [Plan Board Game Reviewer Previews Before Kickstarter](https://guildframe.com/guides/board-game-reviewer-outreach): Prepare board game reviewer outreach with a prototype brief, press kit, dispatch plan and clear permissions before your Kickstarter launch.
- [Board Game Kickstarter Launch Checklist: 90 Days to Launch Day](https://guildframe.com/guides/board-game-kickstarter-launch-day-checklist): A board game Kickstarter launch checklist from 90 days out to launch day. Lock rewards, open the prelaunch page, test ads, pass review and run the first hour.
- [Choose a Pledge Manager for Your Board Game Campaign](https://guildframe.com/guides/board-game-pledge-manager-checklist): Compare pledge managers for a board game Kickstarter by upgrades, shipping, fees, order exports and support. Use a practical selection checklist.
- [How Much Does Board Game Kickstarter Campaign Design Cost?](https://guildframe.com/guides/board-game-kickstarter-campaign-design-cost): Budget your tabletop Kickstarter page by scope: copy, graphics, artwork, video and launch support. Compare quotes and see Guildframe’s fixed page price.
- [Board Game Kickstarter Page Checklist Before Launch](https://guildframe.com/guides/board-game-kickstarter-page-checklist): Check your board game Kickstarter page before launch: gameplay, box contents, rewards, shipping information and mobile readability.
- [What to Send Your Kickstarter Campaign Designer](https://guildframe.com/guides/what-to-send-kickstarter-campaign-designer): Send your Kickstarter designer the game summary, artwork, reward contents and launch plans. Use this checklist to prepare a brief they can work from.
- [Kickstarter Reward Tier Graphics for Board Games](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-reward-tier-graphics): Design Kickstarter reward graphics that show the contents of each tier. Compare board game editions, card decks, RPG books and optional extras.
- [How to Design a TTRPG Kickstarter Campaign Page](https://guildframe.com/guides/ttrpg-kickstarter-campaign-page-design): Build a TTRPG Kickstarter page that explains the game, shows sample spreads and separates PDF and print rewards. A practical guide for RPG creators.
- [Kickstarter vs Gamefound: Campaign Page Design Differences](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-vs-gamefound-campaign-page-design): How campaign page design differs on Kickstarter and Gamefound, from story sections and reward layouts to stages and previews, for creators who have picked one.
- [Kickstarter Campaign Graphics That Read on a Phone](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-campaign-graphics-mobile-readability): Make Kickstarter campaign graphics readable on a phone: one job per graphic, labels that survive compression, and a quick image size reference.
- [When Should You Hire a Kickstarter Campaign Designer?](https://guildframe.com/guides/when-to-hire-kickstarter-campaign-designer): Hire a Kickstarter campaign designer once your game summary and usable artwork are ready. Plan assets, rewards and review time before launch.
- [Kickstarter Prelaunch Page: What to Show Before Your Game Launches](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-prelaunch-page-guide): What a tabletop Kickstarter prelaunch page should show, how it differs from the preview link, when to share it and what followers see in the app.
- [How to Explain Board Game Gameplay on a Kickstarter Page](https://guildframe.com/guides/board-game-kickstarter-gameplay-rulebook): Show a sample turn, explain player decisions and link your rulebook or playthrough so a new backer can understand your board game.
- [Kickstarter Campaign Video: Plan the Main Video and Gameplay Preview](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-campaign-video-planning): Separate your main campaign video, optional vertical Discovery Mode clip and gameplay demo. Check the requirements before briefing a tabletop video.
- [Kickstarter Stretch Goals: Examples and a Planning Guide](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-stretch-goals-planning): Kickstarter stretch goal examples for card and board games, from card expansions to upgraded components, with unlock rules, eligible rewards and cost checks.
- [How to Explain Kickstarter Shipping Costs and Delivery](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-shipping-delivery-page): Write the shipping section of a tabletop Kickstarter: when shipping is charged, regional estimates, delivery dates per tier and what backers should budget.
- [Kickstarter Risks and Challenges: Show What Is Ready](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-prototype-risks-disclosure): Write the Kickstarter risks and challenges section for a tabletop game, label prototypes and renders honestly and check the rules for your category.
- [Kickstarter Review Time and Your Launch Timeline](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-review-launch-timeline): Kickstarter review takes up to 3 business days, plus 3 more if changes are requested. Plan review, revisions and the manual launch with a buffer.
- [Gamefound Launch Checklist: Sections, Rewards and Tester Mode](https://guildframe.com/guides/gamefound-launch-page-checklist): Gamefound launch checklist for tabletop creators. Check stages, sections, rewards and Tester Mode, and budget for Adfound fees before backers arrive.
- [Card Game Kickstarter Launch Guide: Decks, Gameplay and Rewards](https://guildframe.com/guides/card-game-kickstarter-launch-guide): Prepare a card game or TCG Kickstarter page with readable sample cards, a clear gameplay explanation and exact deck and reward contents.
- [Miniatures and STL Kickstarter Pages: Make the Reward Format Clear](https://guildframe.com/guides/miniatures-stl-kickstarter-launch-guide): Present physical miniatures, terrain and STL rewards clearly. Label renders and test prints, explain scale and separate file delivery from shipping.
- [How to Market a Board Game on Kickstarter: A Phased Plan](https://guildframe.com/guides/board-game-kickstarter-marketing-plan): How to market a board game on Kickstarter, phase by phase: the pitch, a prelaunch audience, ad tests, reviewer previews, launch week and the live campaign.
- [Kickstarter Prelaunch Email List: Signup Page to Launch Sequence](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-prelaunch-email-list): Plan a tabletop Kickstarter email signup page, welcome email and prelaunch sequence. Test delivery and explain how your list differs from platform followers.
- [Kickstarter Advertising Budget for Board Games: Testing, Costs and Reporting](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-advertising-budget-board-games): Set a board game Kickstarter ad budget using campaign costs, a capped test and clear reporting. Understand lead cost, attribution and why ROAS is not profit.
- [Kickstarter Campaign Updates: A Practical Plan for Tabletop Creators](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-live-campaign-updates): How often to post Kickstarter campaign updates, a 30 day update rhythm, a delay update template and the monthly minimum Kickstarter expects after funding.
- [How to Choose a Kickstarter Marketing Agency for Your Board Game](https://guildframe.com/guides/choose-board-game-kickstarter-marketing-agency): How to choose a board game marketing agency for Kickstarter. Compare fixed fee, retainer and commission pricing, spot scam red flags and check real proof.
- [Kickstarter Prelaunch Page or Your Own Landing Page?](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-prelaunch-page-vs-landing-page): Compare Kickstarter followers with your own email signup page. Choose the right prelaunch flow for a board game, card game or tabletop RPG campaign.
- [Board Game Tariffs and US Shipping in 2026: What Creators Need to Know](https://guildframe.com/guides/board-game-tariffs-shipping-us): What 2026 US tariff changes mean for board game creators: the IEEPA ruling, Section 301 at 12.5% on China, the end of de minimis and reward pricing.
- [How Much Does a Kickstarter Agency Cost?](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-agency-cost): Kickstarter agency cost depends on the model: fixed fee, retainer or a share of pledges. See published prices, what is never included and red flags.
- [Kickstarter Fees Explained for Tabletop Creators (2026)](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-fees): Kickstarter takes 5% plus payment processing from a funded project. See the cost on a $40 game, plus late pledges, VAT and tariff surcharges.
- [How Many Kickstarter Followers Do You Need Before Launch?](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-followers-before-launch): How many Kickstarter followers you need before launch, using published conversion figures, three scenarios and a worked funding goal example.
- [Kickstarter Image Sizes and Video Specs (2026 Cheat Sheet)](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-image-sizes): Kickstarter and Gamefound image sizes, reward image ratios and video limits in one table, taken from both Help Centers, plus the export sizes we use.
- [Kickstarter vs Gamefound for Board Games in 2026](https://guildframe.com/guides/kickstarter-vs-gamefound): Kickstarter vs Gamefound for board games in 2026: fees, audience, pledge managers, Adfound and Jellop ads, the Indiegogo deal and which one fits your game.
- [Pledge Managers Compared: Kickstarter, BackerKit, Gamefound, PledgeBox](https://guildframe.com/guides/pledge-managers-compared): Compare pledge managers for tabletop campaigns: the Kickstarter Pledge Manager, BackerKit, Gamefound and PledgeBox, with published fees and 2026 features.
- [Trading Card Game Kickstarter Guide: Print Runs, Boosters and Scalpers](https://guildframe.com/guides/tcg-kickstarter-launch-guide): Plan a trading card game Kickstarter: booster randomization at the printer, print run size, starter decks, scalper proof rewards and organized play.
- [Launching Terrain, Dice and Accessories on Kickstarter](https://guildframe.com/guides/terrain-and-dice-kickstarter-launch-guide): Launch terrain, dice or accessories on Kickstarter: show scale and assembly, separate STL and physical rewards, plan add ons and price shipping by box size.
- [TTRPG Kickstarter Launch Guide (2026)](https://guildframe.com/guides/ttrpg-kickstarter-launch-guide): Plan a TTRPG Kickstarter: the new RPG subcategory, Zine Quest or Zinetopia, PDF delivery through DriveThruRPG, audience channels and a launch timeline.
